doc.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Shared use of space and silence with Miles
summary: She agrees her use of silence resembles Miles's; they developed it together and talked about it.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Playing with Miles Davis: joining, sessions and the band

blocks.x: In terms of musically, or musical comparisons between yourself and Miles Davis, I do notice that your use of space and silence was very similar to his use of space and silence. Do you see that? Or when people say that to you, do you see that? Do you recognize that?
Is it intentional? Is that something that you got from him, or he from you?
Well, we got that from each other. We . . . so much . . . we talked about this. So much . . . I can‘t even remember now, but we talked about it. Yeah, we both felt the same about that use of silence.
